<p>This function takes the specified global variable, and transforms the program as if it always contained the result of the specified malloc.</p>


<p>Because it is always the result of the specified malloc, there is no reason to actually DO the malloc. Instead, turn the malloc into a global, and any loads of GV as uses of the new global.</p>
